description: This source file defines the 'Note' entity class for the Apache Fineract project, which manages notes associated with clients, groups, loans, savings accounts, and share accounts. It contains entity mapping annotations, static factory methods for creating notes from JSON commands, and update logic.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing notes associated with various entities such as clients, groups, loans, savings, and share accounts in the Fineract system.

methods.name: clientNoteFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Note for a client based on JSON command input.

methods.name: groupNoteFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Note for a group based on JSON command input.

methods.name: loanNote
methods.description: Creates a Note associated with a Loan object.

methods.name: loanTransactionNote
methods.description: Creates a Note associated with a Loan and a specific LoanTransaction.

methods.name: savingNote
methods.description: Creates a Note linked to a SavingsAccount.

methods.name: savingsTransactionNote
methods.description: Creates a Note linked to a SavingsAccountTransaction.

methods.name: shareNote
methods.description: Creates a Note linked to a ShareAccount.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the note's text based on a JsonCommand, returning the set of changes.

methods.name: isNotAgainstClientWithIdOf
methods.description: Checks if the note is not associated with the client of the given ID.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the text of the note.
